# SmartTicket - Enterprise IT Service Management & Automation

> SmartTicket is an automated IT Service Management (ITSM) and Incident Resolution platform with automated classification, SLA monitoring, and role-based workflows.

## Core Capabilities
- Automated incident triage and keyword-based category classification (Network, Hardware, Software, Access, General).
- Deterministic 3x3 Impact and Urgency priority matrix scoring.
- Workload-balanced auto-dispatch to specialized support teams.
- Real-time SLA watchdog tracking with multi-tier escalation.
- Self-service catalog, approvals, change management, and knowledge base.
